items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yes. He's on that picture with them and St. Cyr... [INTERVIEWEE] And, um, at that time my daddy and Louis were roommates.

ctx.x: Well, my daddy was there when Armstrong came on the boat.
Yes. He's on that picture with them and St. Cyr, I forget who else was in the band.
And, um, at that time my daddy and Louis were roommates. They lived in the Texas above the boat when they traveled from here to St. Paul. And, um, they became quite friendly.
